ipeds.title: IPEDS College Navigator (profile, fall 2024 admissions, 2024-25 expenses)

stats.notes: CDS C1 (Fall 2025 entering class): men 1,992 + women 3,484 applied (5,476); admitted 5,194; enrolled 1,541; residency rows (in-state / out-of-state / international) sum to the totals. International first-years: 34 applied, 33 admitted (97%), 12 enrolled. No early decision or early action; rolling notification. The CDS PDF text lost its checkbox marks, so the C7 factor importance ratings and C8A test-policy box could not be read and 'factors' is omitted. GPA: the average is 3.24 (77.26% reporting); the 'all enrolled students' distribution has 6.43% below 1.0, which makes the 4.0 to 1.0 bands sum to only 93.6%, so the distribution is left out rather than shown incomplete (bands: 4.0 3.41%, 3.75-3.99 31.27%, 3.50-3.74 25.71%, 3.25-3.49 17.22%, 3.00-3.24 10.08%, 2.50-2.99 5.71%, 2.0-2.49 0.16%, 1.0-1.99 0.00%). Undergraduate enrollment 8,219 and nonresident count 234 are the B1/B2 'Total Undergraduates' figures (fall 2025). The CDS carries 2024-2025 page headers on a 2025-2026 collection.

cost.notes: CDS G1 (first-year, full-time, as printed under the 2026-2027 heading): in-state tuition $7,232, nonresident tuition $22,680 (about $756/credit hour x 30), required fees $2,504, on-campus food and housing $13,756 (housing $9,074 + meal plan $4,684). G5 resident estimates: books $2,920, transportation $1,424, other $1,714 (other_usd = transportation + other). UT Tyler publishes no separate international tuition rate on the pages read; tuition_intl_usd is the nonresident rate.
